questions.q: for i in range(n): for j in range(0, n, 2): ... What's the Big-O?

questions.q: s = "" then for w in words: s += w. In the worst case, what can this cost for n words?

questions.q: An O(n²) solution takes 1 second at n = 10 000. About how long at n = 100 000?
